description: Domestic electricity consumptions, renewable electricity generation, GDP and population for Egypt, Algeria, Nigeria and South Africa is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. This file contains annual data spanning 1990-2019 on domestic electricity consumptions, renewable electricity generation, GDP and population for Egypt, Algeria, Nigeria and South Africa. It also contains volatility-consistent pathways to 100% renewble electricity generation for each country; the data spans 2020-2030. Coverage: Egypt, Algeria, Nigeria, South Africa. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. Its tags are Population, Renewable Energy, GDP and Energy Relationship, Electricity Supply. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
